market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely choppy with elevated volatility. Fed hike digested but oil-driven inflation keeps rate path uncertain. Sentiment at 16-month low suggests vulnerability to downside shocks. $7T options day signals positioning reset. Expect range-bound S&P 500 with sector rotation toward energy and value.
market_outlook.long_term: Higher-for-longer rate regime compresses multiples but earnings growth (per UBS) supports equities. AI capex cycle continues but ROI scrutiny intensifies. Structural shifts: Chinese manufacturing in Europe, private markets expansion, housing affordability crisis. Buffett succession creates uncertainty at Berkshire. 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilizes below $90.
